column1: # API-SPEC COVERAGE BASELINE - the routes this repository registers and does not
# THIS FILE IS A RATCHET. api_spec_coverage_test.sh fails when a route appears
# that is not listed here, and fails when a route listed here no longer needs to
# be. So the number can fall and cannot rise: documenting a route means deleting
# its row, and adding an undocumented route means the PR that adds it is red.
# It exists because 48% of registered paths had no OpenAPI entry and the figure
# on #2885 was 59 days old. A number nobody re-measures is not a number.
# Columns: path <TAB> methods (- when the registration declares none) <TAB> where it was found
# A registry `routes` entry is a PATTERN, not a path (capability/README.md:69 -
# "a prefix covers the paths beneath it"), so it only CONFIRMS a path that
# path_template or the source scan already found. 20 such prefixes are not in
# this file: a prefix cannot be given an OpenAPI entry, so counting one would be
# a gap that can never close.
# A path prefixed "(mount-relative)" is registered on a subrouter whose mount
# this scan cannot resolve statically; it is still registered and still
# undocumented, and is counted, because the one direction this census must never
# err in is understating the debt.
